verdict.rationale: Strong first-party (TCP warming to reduce TTFT, dedicated reserved-capacity endpoints, streaming, caching to boost throughput within rate limits) and abundant independent hands-on corroboration (10-50x faster than alternatives, 1k tok/s sustained, benchmarks beating 8x H100 clusters) confirm both fast TTFT and high-throughput generation for latency-sensitive workloads. missing for 10: no independently published formal TTFT/throughput benchmark numbers from a neutral third party (only qualitative community praise) and no public OpenAPI spec to verify latency-related parameters.
